newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Volvo Aero sells parts to Mitsubishi.
newsitem.headline: Volvo Aero sells parts to Mitsubishi.

text.p: Swedish vehicle maker AB Volvo's Aero unit said on Monday Mitsubishi Heavy Industries had bought two rocket parts but gave no financial information about the deal.
The parts, two rocket mouth pieces, will be fitted on the LE-7A, which is the main engine in the Japanese rocket H-2A, the company said in statement.
"A small, but very important order for our space operations," Bjorn Sjoblom, head of Volvo Aero's space division, said of the transaction.
"For us, it is a breakthrough as we for the first time (will) deliver space components outside Europe and European space cooperation."
"We will deliver the components to Mitsubishi today and we hope that this is the start of a longer cooperation."
